meta.source: semester-wise-v2_85.pdf (aSc Timetables export, "Class Schedule", Department of CSE, IUT)
meta.what_this_is: Every lesson card of the current CSE department routine, with the slot and room it has today.
decoding_notes: A card that fills the whole height of a day row is a whole-class lesson held every week.
A half-height card with a group label (1A/1B, A/B, MCCV/Ecom ...) is for that sub-group, every week.
A quarter-height card with a group label is for that sub-group in alternate weeks: weeks = "A" (upper half of the row) or "B" (lower half).
A sixth-height card (7th semester elective labs) is an elective group in alternate weeks; its group was inferred from position.
Joint lessons printed on several class pages (same day, slot, course, teachers, room) are merged into one lesson with several audience entries.
Lessons whose teacher field shows class abbreviations (C7, S3, C1S1/C1S2/SW1 ...) have no teacher: teachers = [].
Any lesson with a non-null "assumption" field should be confirmed with the department.
